name: generating-app-screenshots
description: Render App Store / Google Play marketing screenshots from a JSON config with headless Chromium.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && node scripts/render.mjs examples/demo/screenshots.config.json --locales en-US --targets ios-6.9 --no-preview
scripts.example:demo: node scripts/render.mjs examples/demo/screenshots.config.json && node scripts/render.mjs examples/demo/panorama.config.json
scripts.example:gallery: node scripts/render.mjs examples/gallery/layouts.config.json && node scripts/render.mjs examples/gallery/panorama.config.json
scripts.example:patterns: for f in examples/panorama-patterns/*.config.json; do node scripts/render.mjs "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.examples: npm run example:demo && npm run example:gallery && npm run example:signature && npm run example:devices && npm run example:patterns && npm run example:preview
